transcript.message: Hello, this is calling from our company. Is this a good time to talk about your account?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.message: Hi, yes, this is a good time. I’ve been expecting your call, and I do want to take care of this—thank you for reaching out.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message:
Hi, thank you so much for taking my call—I really appreciate that. This kind of conversation can feel stressful, and I want to say right off the bat that I’m here to help, not to add pressure. My name is Sarah Thompson, and I’m with ClearPath Financial Solutions.

I hear that you’re wanting to take care of this, and I admire that. That’s a big step, and it tells me you’re looking for a way forward. Before we go any further, is now still a good time to talk? And are you somewhere where you can speak privately?

I’d like to take a few minutes to understand your situation better, so we can come up with a plan that truly fits your life right now. How does that sound?
